articles.summary: AI summary: Addressing the UN General Assembly, PM Shehbaz Sharif warned that any Indian move to stop or divert Pakistan's share of Indus waters would be seen as an act of war, calling India's suspension of the treaty legally baseless. He also credited US mediation for the 2025 ceasefire, backed Palestinian statehood and urged Afghanistan to act against militant groups on its soil.
